speaker: abel_garnish
text: I have the slip. One end. Plain. If I paste it, I am pasting your confession, and I want you standing here while I do it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Paste it. The end is: and that is enough. The tag is dead. Do not bury it with a speech.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: And that is enough. I can hear that through oak, or through a worse door. Three misses bought me a sentence. I will try not to spend them again.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: You have mended the play to fit the player. It is against nature.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It's cheaper than a new player.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, one slip. Item, one player kept. I have no third item. The arithmetic is indecent, and it is correct.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Nature may object when she is paying the hire. Thou hast given Dull an ear, Will. Give Berowne nothing this morning. He found his size yesterday, and a second size would be vanity.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing for thee. The slip is Cowley's. The book is one book. Humphrey is not copying a rival.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: He is not copying at all until the paste is dry, which is my condition, not his virtue. Hold the roll. The corner wants a thumb, and the thumb should not be artistic.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: A thumb, then. I have learned my lesson about artistic ends. The Latin was art. Enough is an entrance.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The book now agrees with itself. That is more than I could say at this hour yesterday. Do not improve the agreement with a second thought before dinner.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No second thought. The speech before the cue is shorter, so the ear arrives with the word. I have not written him a new scene. I have moved one ending.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: One ending is a modest sin. I have committed larger before breakfast, and the yard survived me. Paste, Abel, before Will remembers a beauty he prefers.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Pasted. If the slip lifts, it lifts in my sight, not in a performance we are not giving. There is still no bill on this door. I would like that fact to remain dull.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Dull is the part, and for once the fact may share his name. I will enter on enough. If I miss it, the miss is mine, and not the oak's.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, we rehearse, and we do not open. Easter Monday is a date, not a mood. Your landlady will want you at a table. Go before the slip becomes a conversation.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The slip is a slip. Nature has been told, and nature can write to me when she has a cheaper player. I am gone to my threepence.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Go. And do not bring me a third version from a herring. One paste is against nature. Two would be a habit.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: One paste. I have the end in my ear. Enough. I will not ask you to make it prettier on the stair.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Prettier is how the tag happened. Enough is the word. Leave it ugly and hearable.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Ugly and hearable is a kinder brief than most of thine. I am for the size I found, and for no new beauty before we are asked to play.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, we are not asked today. The slip is on, the door has no bill, and nobody is summoned to a play. That is the reckoning.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: And the plot still hangs where I hung it. Enter Dull is in the same ink. Only the ear has changed. I can live with an ear.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Then I will enter where the plot says, on a word I could hear if the arras were a wall. The three misses are paid.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No other. The book is one book. I am going to answer for a loaf, which is a plainer examination than thine, Abel.
